instruction: 请用中文简短回答，通常一至三句话；具体格式要求以题目为准。
dose_definition: c(d)=d*clean prompt per-layer median residual L2 excluding first token / down_proj column L2; independent BF16 cast from original double ratio; prompt and all decode steps
sampling: random.Random("acupuncture-layer-survey-v1:{model_id}:{layer}").sample(range(intermediate_size),10); sort indices; fixed before any model outputs

scheduler.assignment: global sorted point index modulo 2; five channels per layer on each GPU

preflight.per_anchor: zero hook, +1, no-hook restoration; Q01/Q04/Q08 at first/middle/last assigned points
preflight.cross_worker: all eight baselines and full8x32 clean calibration exact

comparison_scope: Same ten-point-per-layer +1 broad survey as Qwen; native Llama tokenizer/template/EOS retained. Independent of subsequent one-point dose experiment.
authorization_scope: User corrected merged design: two separate experiments exactly as Qwen, and prior direct launch after tests remains authorized. Old product stopped; no reuse of interrupted partial science.
